cohort: Women with care established before 20 weeks and diagnosed with preeclampsia with severe features with delivery at ≥34 weeks; women with chronic hypertension or suspected underlying renal dysfunction were excluded
finding: Among women with late preterm SPE, 15% had AKI, with the majority having stage I disease, and AKI was associated with higher rates of cesarean delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, and longer lengths of stay.
